title: Writing to the counter tape
statement: For Boolean lists $u$ and $v$, define their counter tape on integer positions by assigning no value at negative positions and the Boolean entry at each nonnegative position, when that entry exists. For any Boolean value $c$, changing the tape of $u$ followed by $v$ at position $|u|$ to the value $c$ gives the tape of $u$ followed by $c$ and then the tail of $v$.
